content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Ann Arbor

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates hold a bachelor's degree plus a defined span of direct project-work hours. Granite PM Academy's eligibility guide walks you through PMI's specific thresholds so you can confirm readiness before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Ann Arbor-focused cohorts deliver the PMI-required contact hours through interactive, real-time sessions. You'll work through the PMBOK Guide, case studies, and hands-on scenarios with certified instructors who understand the regional project landscape.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the boot camp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI. You'll provide your education and experience documentation, then pay PMI's exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a PMI-authorized testing center in or near Ann Arbor. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before you sit for the credential exam.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you'll maintain it by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) across a standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDP courses and webinars to help Ann Arbor professionals meet renewal requirements while staying current in project management.
